_meta.title: FLUX 3 Klein (distilled int8; base: flux3-image-klein-base-int8-convrot, 50 steps, cfg 3.5)

inputs.text: cropped faces, half faces, text, labels

Film character sheet, photorealistic commercial studio photography, one seamless neutral grey #B8B8B8 background, seven panels side by side separated by thin light grey lines. The four narrow panels on the left are full-body views of the exact same person as in <ref_image_0>, feet to head fully in frame: front view facing the camera, three-quarter view, side profile view, back view. The three wider panels on the right are close-up portraits of the same person from the chest up: facing the camera straight on; head turned about 45 degrees to the side so one cheek is closer to the camera (a true three-quarter view, both eyes visible but the far eye partly hidden by the nose bridge); and a full side profile at 90 degrees. Identical person, face, hairstyle, outfit and styling in all seven panels.

Keep the person's face, facial structure, skin tone, hair and body exactly as in <ref_image_0>. Relaxed neutral standing pose in the full-body views, arms loose at the sides, head level. In the close-ups the face is fully visible and sharp, eyes in focus, natural relaxed expression, clear healthy skin, Soft even studio lighting with smooth falloff, clean commercial catalogue look, crisp fabric and hair detail. No text, no labels, no captions, no numbers, no lettering anywhere. Keep the clothing from <ref_image_0> where it shows it; otherwise dress the person in simple, plain clothing that suits them, the same in every panel. Every panel shows one whole person or one whole face, never a cut-off part of a face.
